title: What Durability Costs
subtitle: 1000 B messages per second under three flush policies, log scale. Median of 3 runs

rows.label: Batch 1, no flush
rows.detail: 32.3 MB/s. Acknowledged after pwrite, data in the page cache. Load average 9

rows.label: Batch 1, fsync
rows.detail: 14.6 MB/s. fsync on macOS reaches the drive but not through its write cache. Load average 9

rows.label: Batch 1, F_FULLFSYNC
rows.detail: 0.2 MB/s, about 4.3 ms per message. Load average 9

rows.label: Batch 1000, F_FULLFSYNC
rows.detail: 197.6 MB/s, each flush amortised over about 1 MB. Load average 8

caption: Every flush is paid per append while the partition lock is held, so batching is the only thing that amortises it. Shared Apple M4 Pro at a 1 minute load average of 8 to 9, internal SSD, indicative only.
